research_notes: July 17, 2026 update. Acuña: FCL rehab ongoing, grand slam in 3rd game, fibula fracture targeting early-to-mid July. Betts: Back stiffness day-to-day, 7-game hit streak .355, post-viral recovery. Freeman: Neck stinger resolved Aug 2025, chronic ankle managed. All players active or rehabbing with no IL placements for current minor issues.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
players.current_status: On 60-Day IL (Rehabbing); FCL rehab assignment ongoing

injury.type: Left hamstring strain (2nd this season) + Left fibula non-displaced fracture (2026)
injury.how: Strained hamstring running to first base. Fibula fracture suffered Mar 3, 2026 in Spring Training.
injury.status: Rehabbing with FCL Braves; hit grand slam in 3rd rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). NOT cleared for cutting drills, outfield, or live baserunning yet. Targeted return: early-to-mid July 2026.
injury.rehab_highlights: Grand slam (423 ft, 112.8 mph) in FCL rehab; 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs. Only DH; no outfield work. Only cleared for BP, throwing, and straight-line drills.

players.rehab_timeline: FCL rehab started mid-July 2025. Fibula rehab started April 2026. Expected return early-to-mid July 2026.⚠️ Must clear cutting drills before MiLB rehab.
players.latest_event: Hit grand slam as DH in 3rd FCL rehab game. No confirmed rehab timeline yet. Cutting drills NOT cleared.

players.name: Mookie Betts
players.current_status: Day-to-Day (Active — NOT on IL); post-viral recovery ongoing

injury.type: Stiff lower back (day-to-day) + right wrist soreness (resolved) + post-viral fatigue
injury.how: Back stiffness not from specific incident. Severe viral illness caused ~25 lbs weight loss and death of stepfather.
injury.status: Day-to-day management. Back NOT on IL. New medication helping with stomach issues. Resumed full workouts. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15 games).
injury.rehab_notes: Resumed workout at Dodger Stadium. Manager Roberts: 'turned a corner.' On 7-game hit streak. Betts noted: 'I feel great. Expects to play. Right now we're in a good spot. Just managing day-to-day.'

players.rehab_timeline: Within days for back stiffness. Viral recovery ongoing — weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs.
players.latest_event: Out 3+ games for back stiffness. 7-game hit streak (.355). Manager Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot.'

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.current_status: Active & Healthy; chronic ankle managed with load management

injury.type: Neck stinger (resolved Aug 2025). No acute injury. Left rib/scar tissue (March 2025 — resolved). Chronic ankle managed.
injury.how: Neck stinger from neck into right shoulder vs. Reds. Scraped from lineup Wed; returned Fri with no lingering effects. Chronic ankle from June 2025 sprain.
injury.status: Active and playing regularly. Chronic ankle managed via load management and rest days. No expected games missed.
injury.rehab_notes: No rehab needed for neck. Chronic ankle managed with rest days and load management. Dave Roberts: 'I feel confident he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.'

pre_injury_stats.prior_context: 2024 WS MVP (Walk-Off Grand Slam). 2025: leading MLB in softball grounds, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate.

players.rehab_timeline: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly.
players.latest_event: Out vs Reds Wed (neck stinger). Returned Fri lineup. Roberts: 'nothing compromising... confident he can get through it.'
